'''Ibdun Dand''' was a [[Tarsunt]] [[Gender|male]] and the [[Parent|father]] to [[Resistance]] [[controller]] [[Vober Dand]]. While Ibdun was originally against his son joining the [[Resistance]], fearing what might happen, he eventually joined himself after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. Dand served as part of the [[Resistance ground crew|ground crew]] alongside his son and celebrated with him and the rest of the Resistance following their victory at the [[Battle of Exegol]].

==Biography==
Ibdun Dand was a [[Tarsunt]] [[Gender|male]] who initially forbade his son [[Vober Dand]] from joining the [[Resistance]] during their [[Cold War]] against the [[First Order]]; however, Dand disobeyed him and became a [[controller]] in the Resistance's [[Ground Logistics Division]]. After the [[First Order]] destroyed the entire [[Hosnian system]] during the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Ibdun joined his son as a member of the Resistance, serving alongside him in the [[Resistance ground crew|ground crew]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Ibdun Dand's appearance}}</ref> he was amongst the personnel that was stationed in the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]]. As the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] was joined by her allies while preparing to leave for the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] on board the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' [[YT-1300 light freighter]], Ibdun was working on a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] parked nearby. After the Resistance and its allies later [[Battle of Exegol|defeated]] the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] above the [[planet]] [[Exegol]], both Dands joined in with the celebrations that took place at the base. During the celebration,<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> the [[Kessurian]] ''[[thilas]]'' [[Wilsa Teshlo]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> patted Ibdun on the back while he stood with Vober and the pair cheered in celebration.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Ibdun Dand initially forbid his son from joining the Resistance because he feared the worse, but after the Hosnian Cataclysm revealed the ruthlessness of the First Order he came to appreciate his son's bravery. While serving in the Resistance he learned more about his son from the people they both worked with. Ibdun had [[Color|gray]] skin, black [[eye]]s and graying [[hair]] typical of an ageing Tarsunt.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Ibdun Dand wore a yellow [[Clothing|jumpsuit]] with a brown [[belt]] and [[glove]]s and an orange [[headset]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ibdun Dand first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
